text:
samira: hi team — i'm samira (starting today). quick q: where do we keep team playbooks and onboarding templates in Notion? i tried to edit the Marketing playbook but edit is disabled.

maya: welcome samira! we keep playbooks under Notion › Company wiki › Playbooks. templates live in Notion › Company wiki › Templates › Onboarding & Playbook template.

samira: thanks — can you give me edit access to the marketing playbook? here's the page link: https://notion.redwood/s/marketing-playbook

maya: can do. two options: (1) open the page, click Share → Invite people → add your @redwood.com. (2) if that shows 'request access', reply here and i'll approve. i'll add you now.

devex-bot: :wave: automated tip — new hires: follow the quickstart checklist at https://internal.redwood/notion-setup. If you need team-level edit perms, @devex is the team to ping.

maya: added you (samira). try editing and report if anything still blocked.

samira: i can edit now, thanks! also — any recommended playbook sections to read first as a PM?

alex: hey samira — start with 'Goals & Metrics' and 'Release Runbook' in the Product playbook. also the 'Meeting Rituals' template is useful.

samira: perfect, will do. one last q: do we have a template for meeting notes that auto-links to JIRA tickets?

maya: yes — Templates › Meeting Notes has a 'Tasks & JIRA' block with a small script. paste this snippet into a code block to autoformat ticket links: `[[JIRA-\d+]] -> https://go/jira/$1`. ping me if you want me to add it to a team template.

samira: nice, thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
